usage.notes: A bounded read-only prototype adapter now exists for the official HRA reference-organ endpoint, but it is intentionally not wired to a public Panacea runtime route or UI yet. Continue using versioned build-time snapshots for stable graph/asset work until caching, version pinning and product integration are designed. The prototype normalizes semantic reference-organ identity only and does not download or expose HRA meshes.

license.scope: The HuBMAP HRA-KG repository states that its code is MIT licensed and its data is CC BY 4.0. This registry entry covers that HRA-KG scope. Any third-party upstream source or separately hosted 3D asset must retain its own provenance/license record and must not inherit this permission automatically.
license.notes: Preserve HRA attribution and version identity. Treat separately sourced reference objects as separate assets when their own entry/license metadata exists.

validation.notes: Use HRA to organize reference anatomy, spatial relationships, anatomical structures, cell types and biomarkers. It is a reference atlas, not a patient-specific diagnostic model and not sufficient by itself for clinical decisions.

provenance.notes: Persist HRA release/version, digital object identifier, source ontology/atlas identifiers and transformation history. Preserve semantic IDs across mesh optimization so visual geometry remains linked to the reference graph. The current prototype preserves the upstream HRA spatial-entity ID plus entity/annotation/reference-organ IRIs without inventing ontology mappings.

adapter.notes: Read-only prototype for `https://apps.humanatlas.io/hra-api/v1/reference-organs`. It enforces a fixed upstream endpoint, timeout, bounded rows/annotations, record-type and ID validation, deduplication, explicit source provenance and fail-closed malformed-payload handling. It is covered by `server/uji/hraReference.uji.ts` and backend CI. No UI route, patient-specific inference or mesh ingestion is enabled by this status.
